author: you
description: Injects x-opencode-session / x-opencode-request / x-opencode-client headers (per-chat / random / manual session modes) for OpenCode v2, optional User-Agent preset selection, and shows the request id next to the message timestamp. Works with Custom (OpenAI-compatible) Chat Completion out of the box; Google AI Studio / Vertex AI sources are supported through the bundled st-patch backend patch.
